purpose: Audit omissions 1517 first attempted Newfoundland colony, 1515 Irish report, 1519 Surrey chronology

records.institution: University of Toronto / Université Laval, Dictionary of Canadian Biography
records.author: David B. Quinn
records.title: John Rastell (the elder) 1517 North America settlement plan; biography published under John Rastell the younger
records.details: 5 March 1517 royal letters and small loan to older John Rastell, John Howting, Richard Spicer; four or more ships with settlement supplies; preparations supervised Thomas Spert; dispersed among Sandwich, Dartmouth, Plymouth, Falmouth, and Ireland without establishing proposed Newfoundland/Labrador colony.
records.limitations: Biography focused on younger John Rastell; the 1517 enterprise described concerns his father. Original dated letters, ship ledgers and financial warrants still needed. Do not conflate with Sebastian Cabot's disputed voyage.

records.title: Report on the State of Ireland with proposals for reform circa 1515
records.details: Add MS 4792 ff.96–110; based on Salus Populi of 'Pandarus of Ireland'; additional 17c copy Add MS 4763 ff.481–495 contains omissions/additions. Archive catalog describes both.
records.limitations: The source is surviving later manuscript collection/copy and the actual 1515 original extent, layers and author need criticism; catalogue alone doesn't confirm every quantitative statement in report.

records.institution: National Library of Ireland source index / Bodleian Library
records.title: Sir William Darcy, Articles to the English King's Council dated 24 June 1515
records.details: Bodleian MS Laud Misc. 611 extracts, NLI microfilm n.4213 p.388; the same collection contains Patrick Finglas on decline of English lordship in Ireland.
records.primary_document_location: Bodleian MS Laud Misc. 611 (extracts); NLI microfilm n.4213 p.388
records.limitations: NLI page search-access only, directly opening may return 403; not original London English Privy Council paperwork; no original quotation reproduced.

records.institution: Irish Historical Studies / Cambridge University Press
records.author: Steven G. Ellis
records.title: Prelude to the Tudor conquest: Henry VIII and the Irish expedition of Thomas Howard, earl of Surrey, 1520–22
records.details: Kildare summoned Jan 1519, arrived London around Sep 1519. In or around Nov 1519 King decided on replacement; enhanced lieutenant title/grant for Surrey in Feb 1520 (TNA SP1/30 f.90, SP60/1 ff.70–73). Major Surrey expedition actually 1520–22.
records.primary_document_location: TNA SP 1/30 f.90; SP 60/1 ff.70–73; BL Titus B I ff.188–192
records.limitations: Only decision to replace belongs to 1519; do not map Surrey physically administering all Ireland in 1519. Critical handoff to 1520–29 team.

records.author: Steven G. Ellis
records.title: Ireland's English Pale 1470–1550, Chapter 1
records.details: 1515 author reported 'only half' of nominal four obedient shires subject to King's laws; medieval shire boundaries differ from modern counties.
records.primary_document_location: Identify original 1515 reform treatise item and passage; not yet settled which preserved copy
records.limitations: Statement is a contemporary policy assertion, not survey of exactly 50% of measured land nor a general island map; no 1515 exact county polygon.
